name: LiquidChrome-TS-TW
title: Liquid Chrome
description: A full-bleed surface of molten chrome: white metallic ribbons twist through pools of black, with sharp specular highlights. The liquid keeps folding and the pointer stirs a local ripple.
use: A product page wants an abstract metal surface that feels premium behind minimal text.
avoid: You need colour or calm: the surface is strictly grey and constantly moving.
a11y: Decorative and always in motion, with no reduced-motion check for the constant flowing surface. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: High-contrast swirls of pure white and near-black, with narrow grey transitions that read as polished metal. Bands fold into hooks and loops, and the brightest edges look like reflected light on a curved surface.
behaves: The metal flows and folds continuously, dragging highlights along as it goes. Moving the pointer stirs a soft ring-shaped ripple at the cursor while the rest keeps churning.
customise: Base grey level, speed, wave amplitude, the two wave frequencies and whether the pointer interacts are props. The metal shading itself is fixed.
weight: heavy: Every pixel runs a nine-sample loop with ten wave iterations, each frame.
